item.name: Get the financial notices for the specified student

request.name: Get the financial notices for the specified student

description.content:
{
                    "DisplayTitle" : "Personal Financial",
                    "ews_guid" : "1AEDCF78-AEBD-4ECF-BD40-2149F2300DB6",
                    "LongDescription" : "Display the financial notices that are relevant to the specified student",
                    "ShortDescription" : "Display a student's financial notices",
                    "OriginatingSchema" : [ { "source":"sdb" }, { "source":"uweo" }, { "source":"irws" } ],
                    "Notes" : "This resource requires any of the following ASTRA roles:
                                 - sws:Support
                                 - sws:StudentFinancialReader
                               This resource supports the following authentication types:
                                 - X.509 Certificate
                                 - NetID
                               The personal financial resource describes a UW person in an academic-centric way. 
                               If the person is a student the person's name will be the name from the Student System. 
                               If the person is a faculty that name will be provided by the HR system.",
                    "Links" : [ "https://metadata.uw.edu/Catalog/ViewItem/Term/studentdata.tuition" ],
                    "Synonyms" : []
                }
